assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution operates autonomous mobile health clinics at any scale, let alone 1,000,000; the Main KPI is not met. A peer-reviewed review describes autonomous mobile clinics as prototypes requiring level 4 driving (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9421545/, roadmap at https://www.arxiv.org/pdf/2204.04841); the projects found are concepts or prototypes (Texas A&M telehealth van, Renault U1st Vision, Toyota e-Palette mobile clinic demo, a Nuro patent). Staffed, driver-operated mobile clinics are mature but small in number: about 2,000 in the United States (https://equityhealthj.biomedcentral.com/track/pdf/10.1186/s12939-020-1135-7) and over 500 in Zhejiang, China, each with a doctor, nurse and driver (https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202507/28/WS6886cddca310ad07b5d924a5.html). Honest limit: both autonomous driving and mobile clinics are established fields; the open gap is safe autonomous operation on rural roads with remote clinical oversight, and work that only redesigns a staffed mobile clinic is not new.

additionalSearches.query: autonomous vehicle mobile health clinic self-driving medical van deployed
additionalSearches.finding: Autonomous mobile clinics are described as prototypes needing level 4 autonomy; Texas A&M van, Renault U1st Vision and Artefact Aim are prototypes or concepts. No deployment found.

additionalSearches.query: Toyota e-Palette mobile clinic autonomous healthcare pilot
additionalSearches.finding: Toyota e-Palette shown as a mobile clinic concept with a nurse aboard and remote stethoscope; no autonomous clinical deployment, dates or scale reported.

additionalSearches.query: number of mobile health clinics worldwide United States mobile clinic count
additionalSearches.finding: Staffed mobile clinics number about 2,000 in the United States, serving about 7 million people a year; no global count; none autonomous.

additionalSearches.query: China unmanned autonomous medical vehicle rural clinic robotaxi health checkup vehicle 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Zhejiang runs over 500 smart mobile clinics with ECG and lab analysers, each crewed by doctor, nurse and driver; no unmanned medical vehicles found.
